paper.title: On the Minimax Regret for Linear Bandits in a wide variety of Action Spaces

settings.name_in_paper: Linear bandit on the L^p ball (lower bound)
unmapped: Action set is specifically the l_p ball {x : ||x||_p <= c} with 1 < p < infinity
Noise model not stated explicitly; KL computation in the proof implies unit-variance Gaussian noise (following Lattimore & Szepesvari Ch. 24)
settings.definition_quote: Let $\cX$ be the $L^p$ ball defined as $\cX = \{ x \in \Real^d \; : \norm{x}_p \leq c \}$, where $1 < p < \infty$.

symbols.c: radius of the l_p ball action set
symbols.p: norm index of the l_p ball, 1 < p < infinity

conditions: action set is the l_p ball of radius c with 1 < p < infinity
d <= (2 c n^2)^{p/2} (as stated in the theorem; the proof uses d <= (2 n c^2)^{p/2})
hard parameter theta in {+Delta,-Delta}^d with ||theta||_p^p = d^2/((4 sqrt(3) c)^p n^{p/2})

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Let $\cX$ be the $L^p$ ball defined as $\cX = \{ x \in \Real^d \; : \norm{x}_p \leq c \}$, where $1 < p < \infty$. Assume $d \leq (2cn^2)^\frac{p}{2}$. Then there exists a parameter $\theta \in \Real^d$ with $\norm{\theta}_p^p = \frac{1}{(c4\sqrt{3})^p}\frac{d^2}{n^{\frac{p}{2}}}$ such that $\cR_n(\theta) \geq \frac{d\sqrt{n}}{16\sqrt{3}}$.

results.notes: Regret written as sum of <theta, x* - x_t> without explicit expectation, but the proof works with expectations, so it is recorded as pseudo-regret. Noise model unstated; proof's KL step implies unit Gaussian noise. Minor typo in the theorem condition (2cn^2 vs 2nc^2 in proof).
